obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic cinematic photograph in a vast closed clock museum during a lunar eclipse. An unmistakably adult woman works as the living clock conservator. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. Across from her stands an embodied skeletal personification of Death in a weathered ceremonial mantle. Death deliberately turns the final hourglass and the last illuminated numeral on a terminal clock goes dark beneath its bony hand. A wilted cut flower releases one final petal beside the clock, supporting the mortality theme while the skeletal agent performs the decisive action. Compose the woman, active Death figure, hourglass, extinguished numeral, and falling petal in one readable wide frame with cold eclipse light and warm dying clock lamps.

bindings.embodied_agent_phrase: an embodied skeletal personification of Death acts as an agent
bindings.mortality_action_phrase: Death deliberately turns the final hourglass with both bony hands
bindings.affected_target_phrase: the affected terminal clock visibly goes dark
bindings.symbol_support_phrase: vanitas objects support rather than replace the active agent
